name: magnisale-app
description: The Magnisale app. First feature: Profiler.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @magnisale/api" "npm run dev -w @magnisale/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @magnisale/api && npm run build -w @magnisale/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @magnisale/profile && npm run typecheck -w @magnisale/api && npm run typecheck -w @magnisale/web
